record.title: Microduck head speaker — a 35 x 25 x 7 mm box speaker (Pollen's placeholder mesh); exact part CANNOT DETERMINE; representative: '3525' 8 Ω 2 W cavity speaker
record.why: THE EXACT PART IS NOT IN ANY SOURCE. Pollen's MJCF carries a 12-triangle placeholder box 35.0 x 25.0 x 7.0 mm named `speaker` in the head (docs/PARTS.md row 38); the runtime only says the codec is a TLV320AIC3104 at I2C 0x18 driving ALSA `plughw:aic3104`, and the community teardown says 'line out' — driver, impedance and whether the codec's own output or an external amplifier drives it are all CANNOT DETERMINE (docs/ELECTRONICS-AND-SOFTWARE.md §7). WHAT THIS FOLDER CARRIES INSTEAD, said plainly: a REPRESENTATIVE. The '3525' cavity speaker is a commodity 35 x 25 mm 8 Ω 2 W box speaker whose envelope (35 x 25 x 6.8 mm) matches Pollen's placeholder to within 0.2 mm in height and exactly in plan. Its figures come from a reseller's spec table (ABRA Electronics SPK-3525-2W-GH, fetched 2026-09-02, docs/, sha256 in PROVENANCE.json) because NO MANUFACTURER PUBLISHES A DATASHEET FOR IT — the maker is anonymous. For contrast the nearest part WITH a manufacturer datasheet, Same Sky (CUI) CMS-35208N, is 35.5 x 20.5 x 8.0 mm (read off its rendered p.1) and DISCONTINUED — the wrong width. WHAT SETTLES IT: a teardown photo of the head, or Pollen naming the part.
record.subsector_why: SCHEMA.md's closed sector list has no audio/transducer value; a loudspeaker converts electrical drive into mechanical motion, which is the closest fit ('actuator'). The atech speaker module on the workshop shelf is sector atech_module, which does not apply here. Stated so the choice is visible.
record.lifecycle_why: anonymous commodity part; ABRA showed 'Availability: In stock' on 2026-09-02, a stock state, not a lifecycle.
record.origin_why: the figures were read off a FETCHED reseller page (ABRA Electronics) that reproduces the maker's spec table verbatim, plus a second reseller page (thingbits.net, XHXDZ-3525-8R2W) and Same Sky's own CMS-35208N PDF for the contrast part — all saved under docs/ with sha256 in PROVENANCE.json. Not 'measured': no speaker has been on a bench here. Not 'standard': none applies. THE HONEST CAVEAT: for the 3525 the 'vendor' is a reseller, because the manufacturer is not named anywhere.
record.bbox_basis: CITED: Pollen's `speaker` placeholder mesh 35.0 x 25.0 x 7.0 mm (docs/PARTS.md row 38, reference/pollen-microduck-simulator/assembled/measured.json). The representative's stated size is 'Size: 35mm x 25mm x 6.8mm.' (ABRA).
record.used_by_why: placed in the head (jaw_soft body) by the MJCF (docs/PARTS.md row 38).
